title: Chose Postgres over Pinecone for vector search
body: Decided to use pgvector on Supabase rather than Pinecone. Reasoning: single source of truth (rows + embeddings in the same DB), no extra vendor cost, and the row count fits in a 4GB index. Considered Pinecone (rejected: $70/mo minimum, separate vendor) and LanceDB (rejected: not multi-tenant).

title: Why we picked Voyage over text-embedding-3-small
body: After A/B-testing on the design-partner gold set, Voyage voyage-3 scored 0.78 F1 vs OpenAI's 0.71 on identical chunks. Cost was comparable at our volume. Defaulting to Voyage for new orgs; existing orgs keep their configured model.

title: Pricing tier landed at $19/seat
body: After three rounds of customer interviews and a Van Westendorp survey, the Pro tier landed at $19/seat/mo with 5-seat minimum. Free tier capped at 100 memories. India tier reflected as approx ₹999/seat alongside USD primary.

title: Keeper runs every 30 minutes
body: Scheduled via launchd with StartInterval=1800. Empirically that catches most inbox writes within one cycle without burning Haiku quota. Doubling to 60 minutes saved ~$2/mo but missed the freshness window for the demo.

title: YC S26 application submitted
body: Submitted the late YC S26 application on 2026-05-29. On-time deadline was May 4 (we missed). Late apps are reviewed on a rolling basis with no promised SLA. Decision expected by mid-July if accepted.

title: Phase 5 LLM provider auto-select
body: Keeper auto-detects OPENROUTER_API_KEY first, falls back to ANTHROPIC_API_KEY. Decided to prefer OpenRouter to consolidate billing and get unified observability across Haiku and Sonnet calls.

title: Switched from npm to pnpm in CI
body: pnpm install on cold cache is 40% faster than npm and the lockfile diffs are cleaner. Migration was a one-line workflow change; lockfile checked in. No code changes required.

title: GDPR erasure cascade design landed
body: Five-phase cascade: rows -> embeddings -> FTS -> audit -> proposal queue. Audit log stores hashed subject_id only. Plaintext mapping lives in controller-private _system/erasure_requests.jsonl. Verified against design-partner subjects.

title: Trust v2 formula uses 6 inputs
body: Inputs: write_count_30d, quarantine_rate_30d, supersede_rate_30d, contradiction_rate_30d, agent_age_days, prior_score. Each input has a documented weight; weights sum to 1.0. Score is clamped to [0, 100].

title: Skill exporter targets locked
body: Shipped four targets: claude, cursor, windsurf, generic. Decided not to ship an OpenAI assistants target — their file-attachment quota and lack of file-watcher API made it brittle. Will revisit if a partner asks.

title: Eval pass rate gate set at 0.7
body: Aggregate F1 was too noisy for a per-set gate because memory.context is intentionally broad (precision is naturally low). Switched the CI gate to pass-rate (% of questions where recall=1) with threshold 0.7.

title: OSS landed under frozo-ai org
body: Repo lives at github.com/frozo-ai/frozo-vault-mem rather than the personal account. Reasoning: signals a real team, simplifies future contributor onboarding, and lets us link the same org from the Cloud product.

title: Telemetry is opt-in only
body: Shipped with zero telemetry by default. Opt-in flag documented in the README. Reasoning: DPDP compliance posture for India-based self-hosters and matches the local-first promise of the OSS core.

title: Tailscale used for remote MCP access
body: Reused existing Tailscale tailnet rather than standing up a new ingress. Bearer token enforced at the MCP layer; localhost-only by default. Saved a week of infrastructure work.

title: Keeper cost averages $9/mo
body: Across the last 30 days, Haiku triage + Sonnet summary calls averaged $9.20/mo on the dogfood vault. Within the $30-50 monthly budget. Spike on day 17 was caused by a 400-memory backlog import.

title: Show HN draft pinned for August 30
body: Drafts written and reviewed by the team. Launch date 2026-08-30 chosen to give us time to ship the conflict-resolution UI in the Cloud product first. Soft commit, not hard.

title: Design partner #3 onboarded
body: Third design partner is a 4-person SaaS team using Cursor. Their gold set seeded into vault-template/evals/. They surfaced two bugs in the Linear connector during onboarding which we've patched.

title: Removed mobile from v1 scope
body: Mobile app deferred indefinitely. Reasoning: web UI covers the read-side workflow well enough for the early-adopter cohort, and our team can't maintain a third surface (CLI + web + mobile) at this stage.

title: Conflict detection uses Sonnet
body: Keeper's contradiction-detection pass uses Sonnet (not Haiku) because Haiku's false-positive rate was 18% on the dogfood corpus vs Sonnet's 4%. Cost increase is acceptable given pass runs hourly, not per-write.

title: Default top_k for memory_search is 10
body: Empirically tuned. Larger values bloated the agent's context budget on every retrieval. Smaller values missed too many decisions that lived just past the recency cliff. Per-call override still allowed.

title: Quarantine status added to memory_status enum
body: Migration 20260609 added two new status values: quarantined and review. Existing rows (active, superseded, archived) untouched. Backwards compatible — existing search excludes the new statuses by default.

title: Dodo chosen as payment processor
body: Dodo handles INR/UPI checkout natively and has a clean webhook contract. Considered Razorpay (rejected: heavier KYC) and Stripe (rejected: poor UPI support). Display price stays USD primary.

title: Audit log uses Pino + structlog
body: Pino in the TS server, structlog in the Python keeper. Both write JSONL to _system/audit.log. Single file format keeps downstream tooling (Lnav, jq, BigQuery) consistent.

title: Behavioral attacker simulation observed
body: Internal red-team simulation ran a low-volume poisoning over 14 days. Trust v2 dropped the agent's score from 78 to 31 by day 9. Detection latency within target.

title: Switched from chokidar to native watcher
body: On macOS the chokidar polling fallback chewed 8% CPU continuously. Switched to fsevents-backed native watcher and CPU dropped to under 1%. Linux fallback unchanged.

title: Linear connector verified end-to-end
body: Linear connector code shipped two weeks ago. Verified against design-partner instance — issue updates ingest as observations, decisions extracted from issue comments. No false positives in the first 200 issues.

title: Sonnet 4.5 used for summary regeneration
body: Daily summary regeneration uses Sonnet 4.5 with a 32k token window. Average summary is 1.8k tokens; budget set to 3k. Empirically the quality plateau hits around Sonnet — Opus didn't move the needle.

title: Weekly full reindex landed in cron
body: Cron job at 03:00 UTC Sunday rebuilds the FTS index and the Lance embeddings from scratch. Catches drift from in-place updates that don't trigger the watcher. Takes ~12 minutes on the dogfood vault.

title: Customer asked for SAML SSO
body: Design partner #2 raised SAML SSO as a blocker for their CTO. We don't have it yet (only Google OAuth). Logged as a v1.1 priority — Auth.js v5 + samlify is the planned path. ETA depends on YC outcome.

title: Decided not to add cross-org learnings
body: Considered shipping a cross-org anonymized learnings feature. Decided to defer — consent flow, anonymization correctness, and the trust story together are bigger than they look. Parked in v3 ideas.
